answer.reason: The claim about pre-training on Dolma 3 and post-training on Dolci is supported. The domain descriptions are a problem. They come from sentences about the Dolci-Think-*-7B datasets, but this card is for the 32B Instruct model, which lists the Dolci-Instruct datasets separately (the metadata names Dolci-Instruct-RL). So those descriptions may not be about this model's own data. The DPO claim is also not backed by any of the quotes given as evidence. Finally, "English" is the language of the model, not a stated feature of the training data.
